objective.value: Answer natural-language questions over a codebase with responses grounded in retrieved source files rather than unconstrained generation.

role.value: Primary Developer — ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, context management, LLM integration, and end-to-end RAG architecture.

repositoryNote.value: Public repository documents a RAG pipeline with Pinecone vector storage, OpenAI embeddings/LLMs, and Slack (/ai-coding-agent-help) as an interaction surface, alongside the Identity-confirmed stack.

problem.value: Developers need answers about how a codebase works without reading every file. Unconstrained generation invents structure; answers must be grounded in retrieved source context.

overview.value: A developer assistant for asking natural-language questions over a codebase. Answers are expected to stay grounded in retrieved source context instead of relying on model memory alone.

architecture.value: Retrieval-first pipeline: parse, chunk, embed, and index source material; retrieve relevant context before generation. Each explicit stage can be inspected and replaced independently. Public repository documents Pinecone as the vector store and Slack (/ai-coding-agent-help) as a query surface. stages: ingestion, embedding, retrieval, prompt construction, response generation.

decisions.value: Retrieve before generate: embed and index the codebase, then ground LLM responses in retrieved snippets rather than asking the model to recall repository structure from parameters alone.

constraints.value: Public repository prerequisites: Pinecone API key, OpenAI API key, and a Slack workspace with API integration for the documented interaction path.

timeline.value: Repository archaeology: public initial commit 2024-12-04 (message: inital commit). Tree contains Codebase_RAG.ipynb and README.md on master. Finer milestone chronology beyond the initial commit is Missing from recovered public history.

decisionRecords.value: ADR-01 (Identity §18.3.5): Retrieval-first architecture — parse/chunk/embed/index; semantic retrieval before generation; stages ingestion → embedding → retrieval → prompt construction → response generation. ADR-02 (repository README): Store embeddings in Pinecone; generate with OpenAI LLMs; expose interaction via Slack /ai-coding-agent-help. Deeper alternative-rejection log Missing.
